```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ============================================================
# BRCA-only Functional Fusion Circos Plot for PDO and Tumor
# - filters fusion table to BRCA genes
# - saves BRCA-only CSV
# - makes circos plot (PDF + PNG)
# - makes legend (PDF + PNG)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(circlize)
  library(data.table)
})
```


```{r }
# =========================
# Shared files
# =========================
brca_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/Unique_genes_TCGA_ICGC.txt"
cyto_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/Reference_genome/Human/Human_ref_hg38_p7/cytoBand.txt"

# =========================
# Colors by expression status
# =========================
exp_colors <- c(
  "up-regulation"   = "#E64B35",
  "down-regulation" = "#4DBBD5"
)
```


```{r }
# =========================
# Function
# =========================
make_brca_circos <- function(fusion_file, out_dir, prefix, plot_title = NULL) {
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Read fusion data
  # -----------------------------
  fusion_df <- read.csv(fusion_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  brca_genes <- readLines(brca_file)
  brca_genes <- trimws(brca_genes)
  brca_genes <- brca_genes[brca_genes != ""]
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Keep rows where geneA or geneB
  # is in the BRCA gene list
  # -----------------------------
  fusion_brca <- fusion_df %>%
    filter(geneA %in% brca_genes | geneB %in% brca_genes)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Save BRCA-only CSV
  # -----------------------------
  out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, ".BRCA_only.csv"))
  write.csv(fusion_brca, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("\n=====================================\n")
  cat(prefix, "\n")
  cat("=====================================\n")
  cat("Total rows in input:", nrow(fusion_df), "\n")
  cat("Rows kept in BRCA-only output:", nrow(fusion_brca), "\n")
  cat("Saved BRCA-only CSV to:", out_csv, "\n")
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Output files for plots
  # -----------------------------
  out_circos_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, ".BRCA_only.circos.pdf"))
  out_circos_png <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, ".BRCA_only.circos.png"))
  out_legend_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, ".BRCA_only.legend.pdf"))
  out_legend_png <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, ".BRCA_only.legend.png"))
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Read BRCA-only CSV for plotting
  # -----------------------------
  dt <- fread(out_csv)
  
  req <- c("chrA", "StartA", "chrB", "StartB", "exp")
  missing_req <- setdiff(req, names(dt))
  if (length(missing_req) > 0) {
    stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_req, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  dt[, chrA := as.character(chrA)]
  dt[, chrB := as.character(chrB)]
  dt[, StartA := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(StartA))]
  dt[, StartB := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(StartB))]
  dt[, exp := as.character(exp)]
  
  dt <- dt[!is.na(StartA) & !is.na(StartB)]
  dt <- dt[nchar(chrA) > 0 & nchar(chrB) > 0]
  
  std_chr <- c(paste0("chr", 1:22), "chrX", "chrY")
  dt <- dt[chrA %in% std_chr & chrB %in% std_chr]
  
  dt[, exp_clean := exp]
  dt[!(exp_clean %in% names(exp_colors)) & !is.na(exp_clean), exp_clean := NA]
  
  if (dt[is.na(exp_clean), .N] > 0) {
    bad_levels <- unique(dt[is.na(exp_clean), exp])
    message("WARNING: Found exp values not in exp_colors. These rows will be dropped.")
    message("Bad exp levels: ", paste(bad_levels, collapse = ", "))
    dt <- dt[!is.na(exp_clean)]
  }
  # -----------------------------
  # Collapse arcs
  # -----------------------------
  dt_arc <- dt[, .(
    n_fusions = .N,
    exp_major = names(sort(table(exp_clean), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  ), by = .(chrA, StartA, chrB, StartB)]
  
  message("Total fusion rows in BRCA-only CSV: ", nrow(dt))
  message("Unique arcs to plot: ", nrow(dt_arc))
  message("Max fusions per arc: ", ifelse(nrow(dt_arc) > 0, max(dt_arc$n_fusions), NA))
  
  message("\nTop arcs by fusion count:")
  print(dt_arc[order(-n_fusions)][1:min(10, .N)])
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Add end positions and line width
  # -----------------------------
  dt_arc[, EndA := StartA]
  dt_arc[, EndB := StartB]
  dt_arc[, line_width := pmin(n_fusions, 5)]
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Prepare links
  # -----------------------------
  links <- data.frame(
    chr1 = dt_arc$chrA,
    start1 = dt_arc$StartA,
    end1 = dt_arc$EndA,
    chr2 = dt_arc$chrB,
    start2 = dt_arc$StartB,
    end2 = dt_arc$EndB,
    n_fusions = dt_arc$n_fusions,
    line_width = dt_arc$line_width,
    color = exp_colors[dt_arc$exp_major]
  )
  
  valid_chroms <- std_chr
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Plot function
  # -----------------------------
  plot_fusion_circos <- function() {
    circos.clear()
    circos.par("track.height" = 0.05, cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0), gap.degree = 1)
    
    circos.initializeWithIdeogram(
      species = "hg38",
      chromosome.index = valid_chroms,
      labels.cex = 1.5
    )
    
    if (!is.null(plot_title)) {
      title(plot_title)
    }
    
    if (nrow(links) > 0) {
      for (i in 1:nrow(links)) {
        circos.genomicLink(
          region1 = links[i, c("chr1", "start1", "end1"), drop = FALSE],
          region2 = links[i, c("chr2", "start2", "end2"), drop = FALSE],
          col = links$color[i],
          rou = 0.8,
          lwd = links$line_width[i]
        )
      }
    } else {
      warning("No fusions to plot.")
    }
  }
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Save circos PNG
  # -----------------------------
  png(out_circos_png, width = 2400, height = 2400, res = 300)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
  plot_fusion_circos()
  dev.off()
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Save circos PDF
  # -----------------------------
  pdf(out_circos_pdf, width = 8, height = 8)
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
  plot_fusion_circos()
  dev.off()
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Save legend PNG
  # -----------------------------
  png(out_legend_png, width = 600, height = 400, res = 300)
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new()
  legend("center",
         legend = c("Up-regulated Fusions", "Down-regulated Fusions"),
         col = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5"),
         pch = 15,
         pt.cex = 1.2,
         cex = 0.9,
         title = "Fusion Expression",
         title.cex = 1.0,
         bty = "n")
  dev.off()
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Save legend PDF
  # -----------------------------
  pdf(out_legend_pdf, width = 2.5, height = 1.5)
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new()
  legend("center",
         legend = c("Up-regulated Fusions", "Down-regulated Fusions"),
         col = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5"),
         pch = 15,
         pt.cex = 1.2,
         cex = 0.9,
         title = "Fusion Expression",
         title.cex = 1.0,
         bty = "n")
  dev.off()
  
  message("\nPlots saved to:")
  message("  Circos PNG: ", out_circos_png)
  message("  Circos PDF: ", out_circos_pdf)
  message("  Legend PNG: ", out_legend_png)
  message("  Legend PDF: ", out_legend_pdf)
}
```

  fusion_file = "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/IPM/functional_fusions_expression_only_PDO.csv",
  out_dir     = "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/IPM",
  prefix      = "functional_fusions_expression_only_IPM")
